title: Pillow Fight Pro-Level Gear
tagline: Tired of losing pillow fights to cheap, inferior down? Equip yourself (and your frenemies) with these padded, yet surprisingly assertive, weapons. Perfect for settling disputes over who gets the last scone, or staging elaborate bedtime reenactments of historical battles. May spontaneously trigger a royal rumble.

title: Mayo? More Like May-WOW.
tagline: So, you're telling me you're tired of regular mayo? I get it. This black truffle infused mayo is for the discerning palate who wants to elevate their gas station egg salad sandwich. Because sometimes, you just need a hint of fungal decadence with your questionable protein choice.

title: Swole Lucky Cat, Bro
tagline: For the superstitious gym rat. Because sometimes, you need a porcelain feline to spot you. Perfect for warding off bad luck *and* gently mocking your questionable form on the bench press. May not improve your PR, but will definitely improve your shelf game.

title: Knuckle Duster...But Make It Crafty
tagline: For the discerning individual who likes their personal protection with a touch of summer camp. Imagine needing to fend off a rogue squirrel while simultaneously starting a campfire. This paracord-wrapped knuckle duster says, 'I'm prepared for both, and I have impeccable knot-tying skills.' Also good for subtly aggressive friendship bracelet exchanges.

title: App-solutely Secure... Maybe?
tagline: For the truly committed nudist colony that still needs to lock up the communal sunscreen. Sure, physical keys are *so* last century. But relying on Bluetooth to guard SPF 50? Bold strategy. Let's see if it pays off when Brenda's phone dies mid-application.

title: Bunk Beds That Fold? Why?
tagline: For the truly indecisive sleeper. Guests coming over? Bunk beds! Guests gone? Instantly returns to... a larger-than-average something. Ideal for the homeowner whose spatial awareness is as questionable as their furniture choices. Finally, accommodate your sleep paralysis demons in style.

title: Herbicide? I Barely Know Her!
tagline: For the discerning home gardener who's ever thought, 'This basil is getting a little too confident.' Perfectly sized for executing precision strikes against rogue chives or sculpting a bonsai cilantro. Finally, achieve peak parsley aesthetic without resorting to barbaric scissors.

title: Spooky Christmas? I'm In.
tagline: Because who says the countdown to Christmas can't involve skeletal reindeer? Perfect for the goth kid who begrudgingly participates in family traditions. Or, for when you just want to confuse your relatives about your holiday spirit. Tiny, terrifying treasures await!

title: Constellation Curtains: Existential Dread Included
tagline: So, your hamster died, and now your apartment needs to reflect that specific level of quiet desperation? These twinkle-light curtains are perfect. They're also great if you're staging a low-budget planetarium show in your living room, or just want to feel vaguely unsettled every time you try to sleep. Batteries not included, just like closure.

title: Photography: Now With Homework!
tagline: So, you’ve mastered the exposure triangle, but your portfolio still screams 'corporate headshots'? This book offers 'assignments' designed to break you out of that creative rut. Finally, you can relive the stress of school projects, only this time with a camera and existential dread. Perfect for photographers who secretly miss deadlines and grades.

title: Vinyl Wallpaper: Instant Cred!
tagline: So, your band broke up and now you're designing a themed bathroom? This book is your shortcut. Rip out a grand of iconic album covers and decoupage your way to a punk rock powder room. No musical talent required!

title: Wine? More Like *Whine*!
tagline: Because your book club is *already* a thinly veiled excuse to gossip, why not gamify the passive-aggressive commentary? Read Between the Wines lets you turn judging Cabernet into a competitive sport. Finally, a legitimate reason to bring a scorecard to Brenda's house.

title: Wookiee Cookies, Obviously.
tagline: So, your therapist suggested 'baking as therapy,' and now you're staring down a block of Crisco. Instead of another joyless loaf, why not inflict tiny, edible Darth Vaders on your book club? They'll be too busy deciphering the melty helmet to critique your Chardonnay pairing. Plus, mini-Yodas are naturally gluten-free... right?

title: Paranoia: The Owner's Manual
tagline: So, your escape route is planned, but what about quicksand? This handbook covers the truly important stuff. Like, what if you're attacked by killer bees WHILE falling from a cliff? It's oddly comforting knowing someone considered these eventualities. Ideal for that cousin who's convinced the squirrels are plotting something.

title: Fifth Element, First Mortgage
tagline: So, your landlord's been extra judgy lately, huh? Maybe it's because you spent your down payment on a screen-accurate Mondoshawan. Yeah, *that* Mondoshawan. The one that probably smells faintly of papier-mâché and shattered dreams. Perfect for intimidating Jehovah's Witnesses or silently judging your roommate's life choices. Just don't expect it to pay the bills when you're inevitably evicted.

title: Goodbye, Savings. Hello, Petunias.
tagline: Finally, a productive use for that crippling nostalgia! Your crippling debt, I mean. Repurpose your yearning for the 90s into a dirt-filled monument to…well, plants. Perfect for the millennial who unironically uses dial-up sounds as white noise, and wants to imagine that their ficus is running Windows '95. Comes without blue screen of death...probably.

title: Bike Helmet: Now With *Bling*
tagline: For those late-night donut runs where you need to signal your intentions to both cars and moths. Integrated lights mean you can ditch the reflective vest your mom keeps nagging you about. Finally, you can assert dominance on the bike path...safely.

title: Pooch Pampering Palace, Ahoy!
tagline: Tired of your Shiba looking at you with utter disdain after a hose-down in the backyard? This elevated dog bathtub ensures Fido maintains his dignity while you scrub away the evidence of his latest squirrel-chasing escapade. Finally, a way to bathe your dog without breaking your back *or* his spirit.

title: Message in a Brick
tagline: For when you need to passive-aggressively communicate nautical obsession via cleverly-interlocked plastic. Ideal for captains whose ships are permanently docked in the living room, this LEGO ship-in-a-bottle provides endless fun of pretending to be a pirate.

title: Goodbye Savings, Hello Glow Rocks!
tagline: Finally, a solution for people who hate money AND walking to their car without tripping. Picture this: you've blown your kid's college fund on these radioactive pebbles, and now your driveway looks like a reject rave. But hey, at least your Uber Eats driver won't miss your house. Probably still won't tip though.

title: Bada Bing, Bada Book!
tagline: Finally, a literary deep-dive for the discerning wiseguy. Need to explain the nuanced motivations behind Tony's duck obsession to your baffled book club? This oral history is your alibi. Just try not to get any gabagool stains on the pages.

title: Guilt-Free Gummy Indulgence?
tagline: So, you're telling me I can still eat an entire sleeve of questionable gas station taquitos, as long as I chase it with a handful of these? Asking for a friend... whose next doctor's appointment might be preemptively cancelled. For anxiety reasons, of course.

title: Mint? Never Heard of Her.
tagline: For the discerning chocoholic who simply *cannot* wait until after brushing to indulge. Imagine: 3 AM, staring into the fridge, resisting that brownie... until now. Just pop a chocolatey dollop on your brush. Dentists *hate* this one simple trick! (Probably.)

title: Hey You Guys! It's Monopoly!
tagline: For when arguing about utilities just isn't cutting it anymore. Now you can leverage One-Eyed Willy's treasure to bankrupt your siblings. Perfect for family game night after everyone's watched 'The Goonies' for the 800th time and needs to process their feelings through aggressive capitalism.

title: Flingin' Chicken Fun!
tagline: Need to assert dominance over the squirrels in your bird feeder? These stretchy poultry projectiles are surprisingly accurate. Forget passive-aggressive notes; now you can launch a rubbery rebuke directly at their furry little faces. Just maybe aim for the tree *next* to them, unless you're feeling particularly vindictive today.

title: Pocketful of "Peace"
tagline: For when your therapist said, "find healthy coping mechanisms," but you heard, "accessorize for potential muggings." Perfect for subtly brandishing while walking to your car after that questionable improv class downtown. Remember, it's not paranoia if they're *actually* after your artisanal sourdough starter.

title: Surf's Up, Shoulders Down!
tagline: Tired of the walk of shame from the beach parking lot? This surfboard backpack lets you lug your fiberglass friend hands-free. Ideal for navigating crowded farmer's markets after a dawn patrol session, or for when your scooter inevitably breaks down a mile from the beach.

tagline: Finally, a bumper sticker for the aggressively tolerant! Show the world you 'coexist' by subtly (or not-so-subtly) telling them what to eat. Well, it's already an embarrassment, so what's one more sticker?

title: Life Hacks For Doofuses
tagline: So, you've reached peak adulthood and still can't open a beer without a YouTube tutorial? This book's for you. Learn to MacGyver your way out of everyday predicaments, like when you need to signal for help using only dental floss and a rubber chicken. (Chicken not included.)

title: Sleep Training: For Parents?
tagline: Tired of your toddler's avant-garde 3 AM interpretive dance routines? The Hatch Baby Rest projects soothing colors and sounds, allegedly for the kid. Honestly, I'd use it to drown out *my* existential dread after another day of parenting. Maybe the gentle whale song will help.

Perfect for when you need to precisely headshot someone while also prepping a miniature parmesan masterpiece. The esports world will never be the same.

title: Knot Today, Ropey McRoperson
tagline: For the aspiring escape artist whose budget doesn't quite stretch to professional-grade equipment. Perfect for securing your collection of vintage porcelain dolls during a sudden, inexplicable urge to rearrange the attic furniture. Or, you know, actual practical things. But mostly dolls.

tagline: Finally, you can film your cousin Barry's interpretive dance at the family reunion without inducing motion sickness. DJI's OM 4 ensures buttery-smooth footage of even the most questionable life choices. Because some memories are worth preserving, even if they're a little... blurry around the edges.

title: Shower Karaoke Savior
tagline: So, your rendition of Bohemian Rhapsody is legendary, but your acoustics are subpar? This waterproof Bluetooth speaker ensures your shower stall becomes a concert hall. title: Alcoholic Scratch-Off Achievement Unlocked
tagline: For the discerning individual whose life goals involve slowly destroying their liver with *variety*. Finally, a tangible way to prove you've sampled enough IPAs to confidently gatekeep at your next family gathering. Scratch off your conquests; become the sommelier of sad dad beers.

title: Personal Apocalypse Bubble, On Sale!
tagline: Is your co-worker a constant conversational spitter? Does your toddler weaponize their sneezes? Deploy the ShieldPod. title: Purrfectly Acceptable Indoor Footwear
tagline: Facing a sudden draft from the floorboards after you foolishly removed the area rug? These plush feline foot-sheaths offer a swift, silent solution. Ideal for padding around the house while plotting your next home decor decision. Just try not to meow at the Roomba.

title: Anxiety-Proof Your Grocery Trips
tagline: Ever feel a *little* faint when comparing organic kale prices? This personal EKG lets you monitor your ticker right there in the produce aisle. Just imagine the look on the cashier's face when you casually diagnose yourself mid-transaction. Finally, some drama to spice up your Tuesday.

title: Alexa, Stare Intently at Me
tagline: Is your dream to be judged silently while you attempt a complicated recipe from YouTube? This swiveling screen follows you around the kitchen like a disapproving robot sous chef. Perfect for recreating that feeling of being watched by a judgmental cat, but, you know, with more AI.

title: e-Reader? More Like Eye-Candy!
tagline: Finally, an e-reader that lets you relive the glory days of those old cereal box decoder rings. Perfect for meticulously color-coding your grocery lists, or perhaps creating a digital mood board for your beige-on-beige minimalist apartment. Just don't expect it to replace your iPad... or a coloring book.

title: Retro Gaming, Reimagined (Sort Of)

title: Escape Reality (Responsibly-ish)

title: Highway to... Bankruptcy?

title: Canine Cold-Head Comfort Cap
tagline: For the discerning dog owner who's tired of their pampered pooch getting brain freeze after a brisk walk in the park. Perfect for those impromptu snowball fights when your dog *insists* on joining, even though they clearly lack the opposable thumbs required for strategic snow-compacting. Because a warm-eared dog is a happy, slightly ridiculous-looking dog.

Finally, something to do with all that Duke's you panic-bought during the Great Condiment Shortage of '23.

title: Foosball & Frosty Beverages!
tagline: For when you need to prove you're both athletic *and* hospitable. Finally, a way to settle office disputes and keep the artisanal kombucha chilled. title: Divorce Your Savings: Table

title: Dry-Erase Your Existential Dread

Perfect for mapping out the optimal grocery store route to avoid chatty neighbors, or drafting that strongly worded letter to your HOA, only to erase it in a fit of pragmatic cowardice.

title: Neck Fan: Personal Breeze Machine
tagline: For the person who's always hot but refuses to acknowledge the existence of air conditioning. Perfect for aggressively power-walking through humid craft fairs while still needing both hands to clutch artisanal soaps and aggressively priced candles. Never let pit stains ruin another handcrafted purchase.

title: Adulting Merit Badges: Stickers!
tagline: Finally remembered to defrost the chicken before 5 PM? Paid a bill without hyperventilating? Reward yourself with tangible proof of your monumental achievement. Just don't blame us when Aunt Mildred starts asking uncomfortable questions about your life choices.

title: Sidewalk Surfing...Maybe?

title: Axe-ercise Your Demons Away

title: Tiny Dictator, Huge Savings
tagline: Tired of your offspring's incessant requests for *actual* human interaction? This orb answers the call. Finally, a way to outsource bedtime stories and questionable dinosaur facts to a relentlessly cheerful AI. Perfect for when you need to, say, practice your tuba in peace.

title: Puddle Pirate's Dream Deck

title: E-Bike? More Like E-Thrill!

Perfect for simulating the ambiance of a crowded animal shelter, from the comfort of your dining room table.

title: Gym? More Like Gym-ish.

title: Flux Capacitor...Sold Separately.
tagline: So, you've always wanted a hoverboard? Great. Now you can *look* like you're floating six inches above the ground while slowly rolling down the sidewalk. Ideal for disappointing your inner child, or perhaps cosplaying Marty McFly at a convention for people who hate fun.

tagline: Is your chimney unusually narrow? Perhaps a rogue garden gnome incident? These animated elf legs suggest a story best left untold. Perfect for confusing the neighbors or staging a bizarre holiday intervention with your in-laws. Just add snow and a touch of existential dread.

title: Aqua Couch: For Liquid Naps
tagline: Is your pool just *too* buoyant? This adjustable water hammock lets you fine-tune your submersion level. Perfect for when you want to feel like a sentient jellyfish contemplating the existential dread of tan lines, but, you know, comfortably.

title: Raid and Strategize: Viking Edition
tagline: So, your weekly D&D group imploded over alignment disagreements again? Channel that pent-up tactical angst into Hnefatafl. This Viking chess variant is perfect for when you need to conquer something, but your therapist advised against real-world pillaging. Just try not to flip the board when Bjorn the Berserker gets cornered.

title: Swaddle Cocoon of Shame
tagline: For the parent who's accepted defeat: Yes, your child is basically a sentient burrito now. Ideal for when you need to discreetly smuggle the baby into that 'adults only' sensory deprivation tank session. Just tell them it's a very advanced aromatherapy treatment.

title: Curated Grooves for Existential Dread
tagline: Tired of algorithms predicting your taste? Embrace the analog abyss. Each month, a hand-picked vinyl record arrives, ready to soundtrack your next spontaneous decision to quit your job and open a kombucha brewery. At least the music will be good, even if the business plan isn't.

title: Brew & Go...Off-Grid?
tagline: For when you need cold brew at that remote campsite but also deeply resent instant coffee. Just picture it: waking up before dawn, brewing a single serving of artisanal deliciousness, all while your so-called 'friends' choke down freeze-dried despair. Passive aggression never tasted so good.

title: Yoga Wheel of Questionable Choices
tagline: So, downward dog just isn't cutting it anymore, huh? This wheel promises back pain relief, but I suspect it's also ideal for that specific brand of existential dread one experiences when questioning all life choices at 3 AM. Use responsibly. Or don't. I'm not your guru.

title: Apocalypse-Ready Baby Taxi
tagline: So, you've committed to that off-grid lifestyle, but Brenda Jr. still needs her organic kale smoothies? This all-terrain stroller wagon ensures your little one experiences the raw, untamed wilderness (or, you know, that particularly bumpy farmers market) in unparalleled comfort. Ditch the pavement; embrace the questionable terrain.

title: Fanny Pack, Fear No Puddle
tagline: So, you're white-water rafting. But also, you *need* your emergency gummy bears and that one lucky dice. This waterproof belt bag isn't just practical; it's for those of us who overcommit to hydration and snacks, even when facing potential submersion. Finally, peace of mind in turbulent times.

title: Ramen Rocket Utensil: Engage!
tagline: For those moments when chopsticks feel *too* civilized. Finally, a way to aggressively slurp broth and spear noodles without switching tools. Ideal for competitive ramen eating contests where milliseconds matter... or just when you're too lazy to wash two utensils. The future of quick noodle consumption is apparently now.

title: Moose Mug: Holiday Hangover?
tagline: Because eggnog tastes better coming out of a moose? Listen, we all have that one uncle. The one who quotes Clark Griswold verbatim every Thanksgiving. This mug is for him. Or, you know, for you, when you're trying to embody peak 'festive failure' while simultaneously hydrating with questionable punch.

title: Germ Warfare, Tiny Robot Edition
tagline: Is your Roomba feeling inadequate? This little guy patrols your countertops, blasting UV-C rays at unseen horrors. Perfect for the Howard Hughes of home sanitation, or anyone who suspects their sourdough starter is plotting against them. (Note: May not actually kill sourdough plots.)

title: Yeet the Poultry: A Sport
tagline: Tired of croquet? Need a lawn game with a bit more… *oomph*? Launch these rubber chickens at the included target. Perfect for passive-aggressive family reunions where actual conversation is strictly prohibited. Just picture Uncle Jerry getting beaned by Beatrice the Chicken. Good times.

title: SpongeBob's Bottom Drawer, Delivered
tagline: Regretting that marine biology degree? Relive the glory days! This subscription box delivers official Bikini Bottom merch straight to your door. Perfect for those late-night study sessions fueled by Kelp Shakes and existential dread. Just try explaining the Squidward plushie to your landlord.

title: Adulting is Just Legos.
tagline: For the recently divorced dad who needs to build *something*, anything, to feel like he still has control. This thousand-dollar Technic Excavator won't fix your family, but at least you can pretend to dig a hole deep enough to bury your regrets. Batteries not included (emotional or otherwise).

title: Goodbye Neighbors, Hello Debt!
tagline: Tired of Brenda from next door judging your questionable life choices every time you step outside? Slap up these solar privacy fences! Now you can sunbathe in peace while simultaneously offsetting the electricity bill you can no longer afford because you bought these ridiculous fences. Enjoy your newfound solitude, you'll be living in it shortly after the repo man comes.

title: Portable Baby Cocoon of Judgement
tagline: Is your infant constantly giving you the side-eye at family gatherings? Suspend them, literally. This travel swing lets you hang your discerning baby from any vaguely supportive doorway. Finally, passive-aggressive disapproval, but airborne. (Doorway support not included. Nor is baby's improved attitude.)

title: Dew Your Lips a Favor?
tagline: For the discerning individual who wants to taste Baja Blast during that awkward Zoom meeting, but can't actually drink Baja Blast during that awkward Zoom meeting. Finally, a solution. Also, it's probably cheaper than therapy to deal with that craving. Probably.

title: Catnip: For Felines of Leisure
tagline: Is your cat underperforming? Does Mr. Whiskers need to unwind after a grueling day of napping and judging you? Meowijuana offers the discerning feline a chance to truly *live*. Finally, Fluffy can achieve the zen required to knock over that priceless vase with *intention*.

title: Embrace the Squeeze, Embrace Life.
tagline: Is your pickleball game suffering because your elbow feels like it's auditioning for a role in a horror film? This compression brace won't fix your terrible backhand, but it *might* trick your brain into thinking it's not about to shatter. Also good for hiding regrettable forearm tattoos at stuffy family gatherings.

title: Embrace the Thumbs, Gamer
tagline: Because furiously mashing your phone screen on the bus just screams 'pro gamer.' This gamepad turns your phone into a handheld... thing. Perfect for when you need to convincingly fake productivity while actually grinding for that rare loot drop, disguised as 'urgent work.'

title: Vader Lamp: Join the Broke Side
tagline: Because apparently, therapy is *too* mainstream. Instead, blow $50 to have Darth Vader dramatically illuminate your crippling loneliness. Perfect for the guy who peaked in high school debate club and now lives exclusively on instant ramen. Warning: May attract the attention of neckbeards and/or your landlord demanding back rent.

title: Porch Pirate Proofing: Solved?
tagline: So, you're expecting that *one* extremely specific package—the antique taxidermied squirrel you won on eBay. Problem is, you also have neighbors who "admire" things. This reinforced steel box might be overkill, but at least Brenda from next door won't be adding Mr. Squeaky to her collection.

title: Drone-Be-Gone: Backyard Edition
tagline: So, your HOA threw a fit about that falcon you trained to snatch delivery drones mid-air? We get it. This…device… offers a slightly less Darwinian solution. Perfect for passive-aggressively hinting to your neighbor that their aerial photography hobby is, perhaps, a tad intrusive. Just remember, aiming is key; nobody likes collateral damage on Mr. Henderson’s prize-winning petunias.

title: Pocket Periscope: Pigeon Edition
tagline: For the ornithologist who's also really, really lazy. Hiking for birds? Absolutely not. Just stand on your porch, subtly spy on avian activity three blocks away, and pretend you're conducting serious research. It's compact, so no one will suspect you're just avoiding actual fieldwork.

title: Pneumatic Prankster 3000
tagline: For when yelling "BOO!" just lacks that certain *oomph*. Need to deliver a swift, silent gust of disapproval to the guy hogging the armrest on the bus? title: Affirmations For the Terminally Online
tagline: Is your therapist tired of hearing you say 'I'm baby?' This passive-aggressive flip chart delivers the daily dose of 'self-love' you absolutely don't deserve. Imagine flipping to 'You're Doing Great!' right before you set your garbage can on fire because your code didn't compile. Because honestly, who needs genuine support when you can have a sassy card tell you what you want to hear... until you realize it's mocking you too?

title: Steal Christmas, Literally.
tagline: Finally, a way to express your inner holiday-hating monster without, you know, *actually* ruining Christmas. Imagine reaching for the last slice of pie at Thanksgiving dinner with *this* bad boy. Aunt Mildred will faint, the kids will cry, and you'll finally have that sweet potato pecan pie all to yourself. Is it worth the inevitable family therapy? Probably not. Will you buy it anyway? Definitely.

title: Dalgona Disaster Waiting to Happen
tagline: So, you've binge-watched a show about extreme fiscal irresponsibility. Now what? This jumpsuit lets you relive the terror of children's games, but from the relative safety of your couch. Perfect for when you want to subtly imply to your landlord that you *might* be willing to play a few games to cover rent.

title: Drunkopoly: Risky Business Edition
tagline: For when regular Monopoly isn't soul-crushing enough. Now you can lose all your fake money *and* your dignity! Perfect for family game night when you want to subtly reveal you're the reason everyone is in therapy. Just add liquor and crippling self-awareness.

title: Wasabi About These Pins?
tagline: For the architect who exclusively blueprints with rice paper, or the culinary student who needs a constant, nagging reminder of their student loan debt. title: Boot Up Your Backstabbing
tagline: For the discerning individual who anticipates frequent, impromptu needs for cutlery below the ankle. Because sometimes, a fork just won't cut it. Literally.

tagline: Because sometimes you need caffeine and a MOLLE attachment point. Perfect for the survivalist who also needs a morning latte. Imagine: You're infiltrating enemy lines, but first, coffee. Clip this tactical mug to your plate carrier, and you're ready for anything... even a lukewarm beverage.

title: Laptop? More Like Laptrio.
tagline: Because one screen is never enough when you're simultaneously managing three different fantasy football leagues while pretending to participate in a Zoom meeting. title: Pocket Arsonist's Starter Kit
tagline: For the modern pyromaniac on the go! Stuck at a poetry slam and need to dramatically burn your awful haiku? This keychain lighter multi-tool ensures you can spark joy (and maybe a small fire) whenever inspiration… or boredom… strikes. Just try not to set off the smoke alarm. Again.

title: Escape Fund (For *When*)

title: Absorbent, Yellow, and Wireless
tagline: Is your desk just…too quiet? Does your meticulously curated collection of ironic office supplies need a focal point? Now you can blast low-fi beats from a porous sea sponge. Perfect for aggressively passive-aggressive cube neighbors who leave passive-aggressive notes about your music.

title: Shower, But Make it Fancy?
tagline: So, you've reached peak efficiency: showering while actively avoiding human contact. Now what? These aromatherapy steamers ensure your morning scrub is also a therapeutic escape. Ideal for when you need to mentally prepare to face Brenda from accounting after 'the incident' with the stapler.

title: Kernel of Truth: It Pops!
tagline: So, your meticulously curated Wes Anderson-themed basement screening room is *almost* complete. Almost. What's missing? The faint aroma of burnt sugar and the existential dread of cleaning a vintage popcorn machine after every viewing of 'The Royal Tenenbaums', naturally.

title: Personal Sauna? Questionable Choice.
tagline: So, you've decided your apartment's lack of humidity isn't just a minor inconvenience, but a personal affront? This steam contraption is for you. Picture it: battling a sinus infection while simultaneously questioning all your life choices in a cloud of lukewarm vapor. Hydration is key, I guess?

title: Relive Your Shame, Digitally!

Perfect for filming your next regrettable karaoke night, so you can cringe at it in glorious low-res forever. Just what you needed: further proof you peaked in middle school, now in digital format!

title: Flux Capacitor Not Included (Sorry)
tagline: So, you *accidentally* acquired a slightly singed DeLorean? And the previous owner left zero paperwork? This manual might help, assuming you can decipher the 80s technical jargon while simultaneously dodging paradoxes. Batteries *not* included... mostly because you'll need plutonium.

title: Halo's MA40: Office Warfare?
tagline: HR's gonna love this. Finally, a way to settle those passive-aggressive email chains in real-time. Imagine: Quarterly reports are due, and Dave keeps 'forgetting' to submit his numbers. Solution? A foam dart barrage. Just try explaining *that* to corporate.

title: Divorcecore: The Arcade Cabinet

title: Machete? More Like 'Mac-Huzzah!'

title: Tapes' Final Frontier: Your Desk

Enjoy the utter lack of peppermint; let it fuel your simmering resentment. Bonus points if you dramatically snap it in half while making eye contact with your boss.

Ideal for the perpetually late mime, or anyone deeply committed to a hands-free existence but deeply suspicious of smartphones. Yes, it's a real G-Shock. Yes, it's on your finger. No, I don't know why.

Perfect for those who want to virtually waterski while simultaneously filing their taxes from the comfort of their desk chair. Finally, a use for those under-appreciated ankles.

title: Two-Faced Coinage Chaos
tagline: Tired of winning coin flips? Now you never have to. This double-sided quarter ensures your aggressively-fair betting streak remains unbroken. Perfect for settling arguments where the real goal is to subtly assert dominance, like who gets the last lukewarm mozzarella stick at the party.

title: Majestic Floatie: Sparkle Pony Edition
tagline: So, your HOA banned real unicorns from the community pool again? We've all been there. This inflatable glitter steed offers a shimmering, slightly less magical alternative. title: Become One With Your Plants

Batteries not included, but a deep sense of seasonal angst is practically guaranteed.

title: Cat Portal: Domestic Bliss?
tagline: So, Mittens has decided the linen closet is her personal speakeasy, huh? This interior cat door is for those of us tired of playing doorman every time she needs to dramatically switch rooms. Finally, she can stalk dust bunnies in peace, and you can reclaim your sanity... and your towels.

title: Drink Like You're Tentacool

title: Umbrella Hat? Hold My Beer.

Learn how to turn that compost-destined fruit into something that will either fuel your generator or help you forget the generator is broken. Results may vary. Probably will.

title: Glow-Up Your Existential Dread

title: Shark Week's Most Boring Gadget

Perfect for when you need to subtly assert dominance over marine life during your next deep-sea interpretive dance routine. Does it work? Who knows! But it's cheaper than therapy after a nibble.

title: Squirrel Ferris Wheel, Tiny!
tagline: Is your hamster developing a deep sense of ennui? Does your gerbil stare blankly at the wall, dreaming of... something more? Introduce this miniature swing set. title: Germ Warfare Wardrobe

title: Shovel? Never Heard of Her.

title: Monopoly... With Extra Grease?
tagline: For when real estate is too stressful, and you'd rather argue about who gets the last pepperoni. Perfect for family game night where the only thing thinner than your patience is the crust. Just try not to actually eat the Chance cards.

tagline: Remember when you should have been doing homework, but were instead losing at vector-based games? Now you can relive that crippling nostalgia in a smaller, even more pointless format! title: Shhh... My Sanity's Talking.

title: Diamond Hands, Warm Coffee.

title: Steampunk Smells, Ruined Dreams

title: Pictionary For Existentialists?

Perfect for those moments when charades just doesn't quite capture the angst of being a small human forced to eat vegetables. Warning: May result in fridge art that requires a philosophy degree to decipher.

title: Majestic A**holes: The Coloring Book

title: Participation Trophy: You Failed

title: Frostbite? Never Heard of Her.

title: Tan Like a Starfish

title: Road Rage Relish Ready
tagline: Because apparently civilization peaked when someone demanded hands-free access to ketchup while piloting a two-ton metal death machine. title: Razer Book: Spreadsheet Slayer

title: Divorce in a Box!
tagline: So, your therapist suggested a "shared activity" to rebuild trust. Maybe pottery was booked. Perhaps you secretly hate charades. Well, here's 32,000 reasons to question that relationship... one tiny, infuriating piece at a time. Good luck. You'll need it.

title: Butt Break: Anywhere, Anytime
tagline: For those moments when squatting just isn't dignified. Waiting in line for concert tickets you swore you'd get this time? Birdwatching and your knees are screaming? This portable seat lets you perch like a dignified gargoyle, judging everyone else's poor life choices from a slightly elevated position.

title: Coloring Books for Sociopaths
tagline: For when mandalas just don't cut it. Finally, an activity to unwind after a particularly stressful true crime podcast binge. Pairs well with a glass of Chianti and the uneasy feeling that someone is watching you through your webcam.

title: Escape the Mom Van
tagline: Beats Studio Buds: For those moments when you need to feign deafness to avoid another excruciatingly detailed description of your kid's Minecraft build. Noise canceling? More like sanity preserving. Finally, blissful silence during 'family fun' road trips. Side effects may include phantom controller vibrations.

title: Icy Beverage Impatience Solver
tagline: So, you're one of *those* people. The type who pre-judges a wine based on its serving temperature. Instead of, you know, *waiting*, this blasts your glass into sub-zero territory. Perfect for when your sommelier aspirations clash with your crippling lack of foresight. Just don't shatter anything.

title: Boy How-To, Hold the Glue
tagline: So, Dad finally admitted he doesn't know how to build a treehouse. Or skip a stone. Or do *anything* Bear Grylls would approve of. Maybe this book can save the next camping trip from devolving into an all-day iPad session. Or, at least provide some mildly hazardous entertainment involving paper airplanes and questionable knot-tying.

title: Snack & Sip: Human Hamster
tagline: Admit it: your finest moments are spent horizontally. Now you can achieve peak couch-potato status. This cup keeps hydration and sustenance conveniently co-located. Ideal for those intense binge-watching sessions where even reaching for the coffee table is too much effort. Never interrupt your deep dive into competitive ferret grooming again.

title: Haute Canine Couture, Darling
tagline: Is your chihuahua developing a complex because she can't pull off the '80s rocker look? These fishnet stockings for pets solve that. Perfect for that ironic dog birthday party where everyone's wearing leg warmers and judging your life choices. At least Fido will be on-trend.

title: Air 2S: Pigeon Envy
tagline: Need to discreetly inspect your neighbor's questionable rooftop garden? Or perhaps capture breathtaking footage of your cat's daring escape attempts? The DJI Air 2S offers cinematic glory for the discerning… aerial voyeur. Just remember to check local laws. We're not responsible for any inter-species territorial disputes.

title: Surprise! Your Cake is Alive!
tagline: So, Aunt Mildred's notoriously bad carrot cake is back. Again. This 'Popping Cake Stand' won't make it taste better, but at least it'll distract everyone when it dramatically presents the culinary abomination. Maybe they'll even think it's intentional performance art? One can only hope.

title: Gardening? More Like Garden-ish.
tagline: So, you're saying power tools are *too* effective? These shears are for the gardener who prefers the *suggestion* of pruning. Perfect for cultivating that intentionally overgrown, "abandoned cottage" aesthetic... or just putting off yard work until next spring.

title: Pocket-Sized Summoning... of Debt?
tagline: Finally, a Ouija board small enough to fit in your pocket AND your dwindling attention span! Perfect for summoning spirits while waiting for your microwave burrito to finish. Warning: May also summon your student loan provider. Side effects include: existential dread, sudden urges to buy crystals, and an overwhelming need to ghost your responsibilities. Because, let's be honest, you weren't handling those anyway.

title: Crypto Dreams, Cardboard Nightmares
tagline: So, you're converting your linen closet into a datacenter? Makes sense. This open-air frame is perfect for showcasing your GPUs... and reminding your spouse that the spare bedroom is now off-limits. Just add zip ties, regret, and the faint hum of impending electrical fire.

title: Robot Vacuum? Divorce Incoming!
tagline: Finally, a way to passive-aggressively tell your roommate they're a slob without actually talking to them. Just unleash this robo-disc of judgement while they're 'working from home' (read: online shopping) and watch the resentment simmer. Pretty soon, you'll both be broke, single, and vacuuming alone. Worth it?

title: Pocket Coffee? Prepare for Spills.
tagline: So, you're the type who enjoys the *idea* of reusable cups but hates lugging them around? This collapsible wonder promises zero spills. Now you can awkwardly unfold a cup at that artisanal donut shop, only to realize you left your wallet at home. Progress!

title: OH YEAH! It's...a Costume.
tagline: Is your community theater production of "Guys and Dolls" missing a certain…je ne sais quoi? Does your spouse REALLY need to lose that staring contest with the fridge? Slip into this refreshing behemoth and become everyone's favorite sugary pitcher of chaos. Hydration never looked so…inflatable.

title: Tears of Pure, Spicy Regret
tagline: So, you've mastered the ghost pepper. Scotch bonnets are child's play. Now what? Elijah's Xtreme Regret. Because sometimes you need to question every life choice you've ever made while simultaneously sweating through your eyeballs. Perfect for that Tuesday night existential crisis.

title: Gut Check: Digitized!
tagline: For the data-obsessed dieter who needs to know *exactly* how much holiday cheer they've accumulated. Ditch the floppy fabric tape measure. Now you can upload your overindulgence directly to the cloud. Perfect for passive-aggressively 'motivating' your family group chat.

title: Caffeine With a Bang!
tagline: For those mornings when your coffee needs an extra shot of... realism. Perfect for sipping while planning your escape from that overly enthusiastic office paintball tournament. Ceramic construction ensures structural integrity, even if your focus isn't quite there yet.

title: Patty in Your Pocket
tagline: For the truly indecisive dieter. Jot down all the reasons you *shouldn't* order that double bacon cheeseburger. Then, conveniently forget you wrote them. These burger notes also work for passive-aggressively reminding your roommate to buy more ground beef. Layers of delicious reminders!

title: Keys to Illumination?
tagline: For when you need to unlock... a dark cabinet. Or maybe you're cosplaying a particularly resourceful dungeon master. This key-shaped flashlight blends seamlessly with your everyday carry, until you're rummaging for your actual keys, blinded by its tiny, judgmental beam.

title: Pitifully Precise Cherry Spoons
tagline: For the truly obsessive baker who needs *exactly* 1/4 teaspoon of cherry extract. No more, no less. Because Aunt Mildred's prize-winning cherry pie recipe hinges on that single molecule of flavor. God forbid you use a *normal* spoon. Mildred would never forgive you.

title: Yeti: For Bourbon, Not Bears.
tagline: Eight hundred dollars to keep your artisanal ice frozen? Absolutely. Imagine: you're hosting a chess tournament in the Nevada desert. The stakes? Bragging rights and the last bottle of Pappy Van Winkle. This cooler ensures your victory remains properly chilled. (Chess pieces not included).

title: Ergonomics? We Barely Knew 'Em
tagline: So, your thumbs are tired of that pristine, minimalist controller life? The SHAKS S5b understands. Imagine needing to navigate a sprawling open-world RPG one-handed, while simultaneously stirring a pot of artisanal bone broth. This... *thing*... gives you enough buttons to almost pull that off. Good luck explaining it to your cat.

title: Heated Doormat of Passive Aggression
tagline: For the neighbor who meticulously shovels their walk while glaring at your perpetually icy stoop. Now you can one-up them without lifting a finger. Just plug in this heated mat and watch their resentment *melt* away. Perfect for passive-aggressive snow removal.

title: Could This *BE* Any Tastier?
tagline: So, your Central Perk cosplay group decided to actually *eat* at your next gathering? Instead of just drinking endless coffee and arguing about who gets to be Rachel? This book ensures your 'mockolate' chip cookies are screen-accurate. Just... maybe warn people beforehand.

title: Edible? Asking for a Friend.
tagline: So, you're telling me I can't just use regular massage oil as frosting? This whipped version allegedly stays put better. Ideal for when you're trying to prank your roommate by 'redecorating' them while they're asleep... with 'cake'.

title: Earwax: The Final Frontier
tagline: Ever wish you could excavate your ear canals like a tiny, personal archeological dig? AirSquares aren't Q-tips; they're more like miniature, sonic-powered shovels. Perfect for that one friend who unironically enjoys popping zits and needs a new hobby.

title: Braaaains... and First Aid?
tagline: So, your prepper friend *insists* the undead are coming. Instead of mocking them (again), arm them with these. Imagine: mid-apocalypse, hordes closing in, and Brenda's frantically quizzing herself on tourniquet placement. Hey, at least *someone's* trying to stay sharp.

title: Pickle Pucker Power!
tagline: For those moments when you need to subtly assert your dominance at the farmer's market. Imagine: someone tries to haggle down the price of heirloom tomatoes. You simply apply this balm, make intense eye contact, and relish their discomfort. Dill-iciously effective.

title: Guerilla Cinema, Backyard Edition
tagline: Neighbors complaining about your experimental kazoo orchestra? Project a silent film over their house. This foldable 100" screen is perfect for passive-aggressive art installations. Just BYO projector and a healthy dose of spiteful creativity.

title: Illuminated Mitts of Mirth
tagline: Ever tried assembling IKEA furniture in a power outage while simultaneously holding a toddler? These flashlight gloves are for *that* specific scenario. Suddenly, fumbling for screws in the dark becomes a hands-free, albeit slightly absurd, ballet of light. Just try not to blind the kid.

title: Chili Socks: Office Disaster Ready
tagline: Forgot to prepare a dish for the office potluck *again*? These socks are your last-ditch effort. While they won't fool anyone into thinking you spent hours simmering a proper chili, they *will* spark a conversation. Just be prepared to explain... everything. And maybe order pizza.

title: Alien Abduction Vacation Home
tagline: So, your therapist suggested exposure therapy to deal with your crippling fear of xenomorphs? Excellent choice! Instead of, you know, *not* confronting your fears, why not spend your life savings on a trip to the HR Giger Museum? Perfect for traumatizing yourself further, all while contemplating the fleeting nature of existence...and your empty bank account.

title: Romance? More Like Ro-MEAT-nce.
tagline: Forget flowers. This Valentine's Day, declare your undying love with dehydrated cow. Perfect for the partner who secretly hates chocolate and romantic gestures, but appreciates a good chew. Finally, a gift that says, "I get you... and your intense sodium cravings."

title: Witness The Absurd: Cam Edition
tagline: Paranoid your neighbor's cat is sabotaging your prize-winning petunias? Or maybe you're documenting your harrowing commute for a future art film? This wide-angle dashcam captures it all. Mount it, forget it, and years later, sift through hours of footage, hoping to find... something. Probably just squirrels.

title: N64: Now With *More* Cartridges!
tagline: Remember meticulously labeling all your N64 carts? Now do it again. This anthology packs nearly every game onto one slightly-less-dust-collecting device. Ideal for the person who insists on bringing 300+ games to their cousin's house, "just in case."

title: Barely There Brain Bucket
tagline: For when you want the wind in your hair and the *suggestion* of safety. Ideal for quickly popping down to the apothecary for rare herbs needed in your anti-aging serum. Just remember, asphalt is also an exfoliant, albeit a rather aggressive one.

title: Tamagotchi, But Make It Existential
tagline: Is your child desperately seeking validation from a soulless hunk of plastic? The Tobi Robot Smartwatch offers glitchy animations and rudimentary 'games' to fill that void. Perfect for distracting them while you contemplate your own increasingly digitized existence. And it tells time, I guess.

title: The "Talk To The Hand" Phone
tagline: For the pre-teen who's already mastered the art of silent treatment. This brick lets them text (maybe), call (sometimes), and otherwise ignore you with stylish, 90's pager-esque panache. Finally, a device that perfectly mirrors their teenage angst. Excellent for practicing minimalist communication.

title: Roast Marshmallows, Impress Neighbors.
tagline: Neighbors judging your overgrown lawn? Distract them with a mesmerizing inferno in this minimalist fire pit. Its geometric design screams 'I have disposable income and a penchant for controlled burns.' Perfect for contemplating existential dread while incinerating old tax returns.

title: Honesty, or Hangover?
tagline: Regret avoidance, bottled. Because sometimes you *really* need to know if your Aunt Carol actually likes your new haircut, but you're too polite to just *ask*. Guaranteed to either spark enlightening conversation or end friendships. Use responsibly (or irresponsibly, we're not the boss of you).

title: Zippo's Tiny Dragon Breath
tagline: So, you're telling me you need a *torch*... for creme brulee? Or maybe your artisanal marshmallows require a level of char that only a miniature flamethrower can provide. Forget lighting birthday candles; this'll cauterize the wick right off. Just try not to set your beard on fire.

title: Road Pizza? More Like Bed
tagline: For the home mechanic who's also secretly a cat. Imagine: You're under the '87 Camry, wrestling with a rusty bolt, and suddenly realize the concrete is radiating pure, unadulterated *cold*. No problem! Just flop onto your personal creeper-coaster and continue your vehicular spelunking in comfort. Just try not to fall asleep.

title: Obsessive Cinephile's Sanity Test
tagline: Is your Letterboxd account not quite enough? This fill-in filmography lets you physically document every film you've ever seen. Perfect for settling those late-night 'Did I *actually* watch that?' arguments with your equally film-obsessed partner. Just try not to spill popcorn butter on it; archival quality is *not* guaranteed.

title: Alienware: For Digital Hoarders
tagline: Need to archive every Twitch stream you've ever half-watched? This glowing monolith has enough processing power to render your extensive collection of 'rare' Pepes into NFTs. Finally, a machine powerful enough to justify your crippling data addiction. (Side effects may include: cable management nightmares).

title: The Force is... Unwell?
tagline: So, your Wookiee roommate had too much Bantha jerky and now he's complaining about a droid ache? Skip the med-bay fees. This classic game, Star Wars-ified, lets you practice your bedside manner on Darth Vader. Just try not to set off the buzzer, or he'll FORCE you to listen to his feelings.

title: Crib So Clear, It's Concerning
tagline: For the parent who needs to micromanage sleep. Now you can watch your offspring's REM cycles with crystal clarity, all while pondering if they're dreaming of overthrowing you. Perfect for maintaining constant vigilance... or fueling your burgeoning anxiety disorder. Priced like a small car, because why not?

title: Sidewalk Surfing, Winter Edition
tagline: For the discerning individual who finds traditional ice rinks far too… pedestrian. Imagine: you're late for that underground cheese-tasting club meeting, a blizzard hits, and suddenly, the city becomes your personal, albeit slightly terrifying, skating rink. Just try not to think about the road salt.

title: One Love, One Lava Lamp
tagline: Need a mellow vibe for your tax audit? This Bob Marley lava lamp provides the perfect ambiance for contemplating complex deductions. Let the swirling wax ease your anxieties as you ponder the nuances of Schedule C. Just try not to stare directly into it while filling out Form 8829.

title: Therapist Bills About To Drop
tagline: Is your cross-country move causing an existential crisis? Calm your nerves and color in the states you’ve conquered. Perfect for that aggressively nomadic friend who needs a soothing, cartographically-accurate way to express their feelings about leaving Tulsa. Crayons not included (because *that* would be too easy).

title: Astronaut Training...In Your Pajamas.
tagline: Neighbors complaining about your 3 AM interpretive dance routines? The MoonRun lets you jog in place, tethered to the wall, like you're prepping for a low-gravity spacewalk. Finally, a way to burn calories while simultaneously avoiding eye contact with the outside world. Personal trainer not included (thank god).

title: Pocket Blade, Tiny Flex
tagline: For the minimalist survivalist who's also a watch enthusiast. Need to liberate a high-end Swiss watch from its infuriatingly tamper-proof packaging *without* scratching the brushed titanium case? This miniature carbon fiber and titanium knife is your scalpel of sophisticated unboxing.

title: Pooch Pouch: BYOP!
tagline: Is your chihuahua tired of walking the red carpet (aka, your living room)? Now Bartholomew can oversee your grocery runs from a climate-controlled viewing platform. Perfect for the urban misanthrope who needs a furry excuse to avoid eye contact. Dog not included... unfortunately.

title: Burger-pedia: Bob's Kitchen Bible
tagline: Forget culinary school. This book lets you recreate the 'Bet It All On Black Garlic Burger' without accidentally burning down your apartment. Perfect for impressing (or confusing) your Tinder date when they ask if you 'cook'. Just... maybe don't actually bet it all on black garlic.

title: Blackhead Battle Station
tagline: For when you're stress-baking sourdough at 3 AM and suddenly realize your pores are staging a full-blown rebellion. Skip the Zoom meeting; deploy the arsenal. Because sometimes, self-care is just aggressive extraction. Also, probably see a dermatologist.

title: Bell Tent: Glamping or Bust
tagline: So, your HOA banned permanent yurts? I get it. This waterproof bell tent lets you LARP as a nomadic yurt-dweller on weekends. Impress your neighbors with your 'sustainable lifestyle' before they realize you're just camping in your backyard again.

title: Doomsday Clock (But Fancy)
tagline: So, your bunker's solar panels failed (again). Good news! This Garmin Tactix Delta watch can still tell you the precise moment the last barista runs out of oat milk. It's also great for navigating that abandoned Costco parking lot after society collapses. Assuming you remember how to read a map.

title: Desk: Now with 10% More Edge!
tagline: Is your current desk simply not *aggressive* enough? This 55" gaming desk features more hard angles than a geometry textbook. Perfect for the aspiring Twitch streamer whose parents still pay the bills, and needs to physically manifest their online persona. Comes with cupholder, because Mountain Dew.

title: Beet Your Mortician's Here!
tagline: So, your doctor finally cornered you about your impending doom? Instead of, like, vegetables, you're gonna chew these beet-flavored sadness squares. Picture it: popping one as you max out your credit card on a jet ski. Because *nothing* says 'healthy lifestyle' like impending debt and questionable life choices. Enjoy the placebo effect, you absolute disaster.

title: Betrayal! The Card Game.
tagline: For when you suspect Mittens is secretly running a feline crime syndicate. This card game lets you act out your darkest pet conspiracy theories without, you know, *actually* accusing the cat. Great for awkward family gatherings where someone brings up politics.

title: Solve This, Smarty Pants
tagline: So your escape room skills peaked at amateur? This Japanese Puzzle Box offers a more portable, less judgmental challenge. Perfect for stashing that emergency chocolate stash away from your sugar-crazed relatives, or for proving to yourself that you can, in fact, still follow instructions. Just try not to rage-quit.

title: Clever Girl Cleans Up Nicely
tagline: For the paleontology enthusiast plagued by exhibitionist tendencies, this shower curtain provides essential modesty. Finally, you can reenact your favorite scene from *Jurassic Park* without startling the neighbors. (Just remember to turn off the water before the velociraptor attacks. Plumbing repairs are expensive.)

title: Estate Planning for Procrastinators
tagline: So, you've put off writing a will. Understandable. But what happens when you spontaneously combust during karaoke night? This handy guide ensures your prized collection of porcelain frogs doesn't end up with your estranged cousin, Brenda. Because let's face it, Brenda doesn't deserve them.

title: Smoke Like a Pharaoh (Maybe)
tagline: For when you need to subtly flex on your poker night buddies, but only have the ingredients for a questionable hand-rolled cigarette. Because nothing says 'I'm bluffing' like incinerating precious metals. Side effects may include an existential crisis about the value of currency.

title: Therapy? Nah, Cookies.
tagline: So, your therapist just suggested you "find healthy coping mechanisms"? Clearly, they haven't seen these Belgian Chocolate Salted Caramel Cookies. Imagine: your ex is getting married, your boss hates you, and your cat just coughed up a hairball on your favorite rug. Solution? Shove these directly into your face until the pain… well, at least fades a little. Just remember, diabetes is a thing. But so is happiness... fleeting, cookie-flavored happiness.

title: Digital Firewood, Anyone?
tagline: So, your crypto dreams didn't pan out, huh? Now you're stuck with this… beast. I'm picturing a very specific use case: silently judging your friend's ray-tracing in Cyberpunk while simultaneously heating a small apartment. Just don't try powering a toaster with it; trust me on this one.

title: Tuna Tears: No More!
tagline: For the discerning individual who insists on consuming tuna directly from the can (we've all been there), but is absolutely repulsed by rogue droplets of brine. Finally, a civilized solution for a truly uncivilized practice. Your cat might be jealous.

title: RGB Your Way Out
tagline: So, your betta fish, Bartholomew, is demanding a more stimulating environment? These modular light panels let you create a custom, color-shifting backdrop for his tank. Finally, Bartholomew can enjoy a rave-like atmosphere without the pesky crowds, or, you know, the ability to comprehend what's happening.

title: Guac Lock: Pocket Edition
tagline: Finally, a safe place to stash that emergency fiver. Ideal for those moments when you need to subtly bribe a parking attendant after 'misunderstanding' the signage at the farmer's market. Just try explaining to the TSA why it smells faintly of lime.

title: Sunrise Alarm? I'm Intrigued.
tagline: For those of us who dream of dramatic exits. Imagine: you're starring in your own arthouse film, and the only way to wake up is with a simulated dawn. Perfect for dramatically rising from bed while existential dread slowly creeps in, accompanied by the gentle chirping of synthetic birds.

title: Land Yacht for Landlocked Folks
tagline: Apartment balcony looking a little…underwhelming? Inject some 'big rig' energy without the actual moving violations. Perfect for confusing the HOA or finally fulfilling that childhood dream of becoming a trucker without, you know, the actual trucking. Just add lawn chairs and a cooler of lukewarm soda.

title: Nose Beers: A Portable Solution
tagline: For the discerning enthusiast who demands on-the-go access. Finally, a discreet way to manage your powdered... supplements. Imagine: you're at a mime convention, the energy is flagging, and inspiration wanes. Don't resort to charades! This compact dispenser ensures your performance never suffers a *silent* setback. Batteries not included (obviously).

title: Decision Paralysis? Roll With It
tagline: Can't decide what takeout to order? Sick of passive-aggressive coin flips? This ring lets you outsource life's tiny, irritating choices to the cold, uncaring embrace of probability. Perfect for settling disputes with the cat over who gets the sunny spot on the couch.

title: Amphibious Anthems: The Bugani Speaker
tagline: Planning a synchronized swimming routine for your pet newts? Need a sonic backdrop for your next interpretive dance in the koi pond? The Bugani Bluetooth Speaker is IPX7 waterproof, meaning it'll probably survive your artistic endeavors better than your dignity. Sounds... adequate.

title: Nasal Swab Roulette, Anyone?
tagline: Remember the thrill of at-home science kits as a kid? Now relive that joy (and existential dread) with this COVID test. Perfect for when you need to prove to your extremely cautious D&D group that you're not Patient Zero before venturing into the dungeon... I mean, basement.

title: Bankruptcy: Now Served Sunny-Side Up!
tagline: Because apparently, toast is too hard. This book promises to elevate your breakfast game beyond cereal and self-loathing. Finally, you can overcomplicate eggs benedict instead of paying your electric bill! Who needs power when you have hollandaise sauce, am I right? Prepare to spend your entire Saturday morning failing to make a decent waffle. Your landlord will understand.

title: Coloring Books From Cellblock H
tagline: For the true crime enthusiast who finds podcasts *too* stimulating. Finally, a way to unwind after a long day of true crime documentaries. Perfect for quietly judging your houseguests' art skills during awkward silences, all while subtly hinting at your own intense interests.

title: Roast Your Friends: The Game
tagline: So, therapy's expensive, and passive-aggressive potlucks only go so far. Need a way to air grievances with your friend group without *actual* bloodshed? This party game lets you find out who *really* thinks you peaked in high school. Perfect for Thanksgiving... or a tense divorce party.

title: Almond Inferno: Why Not?
tagline: So, plain almonds are boring. Agreed. But did you *need* to coat them in spicy rooster sauce? Maybe. If you're trapped in a silent retreat and the only way to signal for help is through aggressively flavored nut consumption, these Sriracha almonds are crucial. Otherwise? Well, they exist.

title: Skeletor's Desk-ercise Buddy
tagline: Stuck in back-to-back Zoom meetings? This miniature, motivational Skeletor will keep your spirits high. Perfect for subtly conveying 'I'd rather be ruling Eternia' during those excruciating budget reviews. He-Man not included (thankfully).

title: Sun-Charged Mood Lighting
tagline: Tired of running extension cords for your garden gnome rave? This solar chandelier soaks up rays all day so your ceramic buddies can party well into the night. Because who needs fireflies when you've got slightly-less-sad, sun-powered faux elegance?

title: Robo-Peeping: Now Budget-Friendly!
tagline: Finally, a way to monitor your cat's obsessive staring at the neighbor's bird feeder, remotely. Or maybe you just need to prove to your roommate that, yes, the dust bunnies *are* multiplying. Either way, this pan-and-scan cam is cheaper than therapy (for you *or* the dust bunnies).

title: Pocket-Sized Existential Dread, Now!
tagline: For those moments when you need to subtly convey to your therapist that you're *really* not okay, but words fail. This trinket perfectly encapsulates the feeling of impending doom one experiences while waiting for a Zoom meeting to start. At least it's shiny.

title: Release the Kraken... Kite?
tagline: So, you've decided regular kite-flying is for… *children*. I get it. This colossal cephalopod soars through the air like a misunderstood god. Imagine the looks you'll get at the beach, less 'sandcastle architect,' more 'summoner of the deep.' Just try not to accidentally trigger any ancient prophecies.

title: Square Games, Round Fun?
tagline: So, you've curated a shelf of pristine, original cartridges. Excellent. Now, imagine the subtle horror of actually *playing* them. This little HD box solves that existential problem. Finally, you can experience 8 and 16-bit bliss on your 4K TV, without risking wear-and-tear on your precious relics. It's perfect for when you're feeling nostalgic, but also profoundly lazy.

title: Lie Better, Loser.
tagline: Finally, a game for pathological liars! Perfect for that family member who claims they invented Post-Its but "lost the patent." This board game lets you hone your deception skills, so you can blame your coworker for microwaving fish without a shred of remorse. Warning: May not improve your actual life, but will definitely make you insufferable at parties. Enjoy being broke AND friendless!

title: Undead Heat for Undead Appetites
tagline: So, the apocalypse is here, and you're the designated cook for your ragtag group of survivors. Problem? Even zombies have standards. This Cajun hot sauce might be the only thing standing between you and a full-scale undead mutiny over flavor profiles. It's either this, or start rationing brains again. Good luck.

title: Bee & Bee: Bamboo Edition
tagline: Tired of the neighborhood bees buzzing around aimlessly, lacking direction? Give them a mortgage! This charming bamboo structure provides individual nesting chambers. Perfect for the apiarist who wants to gentrify their garden and dramatically raise local honey prices.

title: Escape Pod for Introverts
tagline: So, your book club retreat took a turn? This ultralight tent is for when you need to *literally* distance yourself. Imagine: passive-aggressive campfire songs fade as you zip into your breathable nylon sanctuary. Just you, a headlamp, and the sweet, sweet sound of enforced solitude.

title: Leprechaun Rave Starter Kit
tagline: So, your St. Patrick's Day-themed hamster habitat needs some ambiance? These shamrock string lights are the low-voltage solution. Forget subtlety; embrace the aggressively Irish aesthetic. Perfect for distracting the neighbors from your questionable bagpipe skills.

title: Divorce? Buy This Motorcycle!
tagline: Is your mid-life crisis not quite loud enough? This $17,500 electric motorcycle will ensure your neighbors KNOW you're unhappy. Perfect for silently speeding away from your responsibilities... and directly into crippling debt. Because who needs retirement savings when you have *eco-friendly* regret?

title: Divorce Your Guitarist!
tagline: Finally, a way to annoy your neighbors without learning an actual instrument! Perfect for when your band kicks you out for 'artistic differences' (you kept trying to incorporate dolphin noises). Now you can serenade the alley cats with your thumb-powered rendition of 'Chopsticks,' all for the low, low price of ramen money.

title: Halo: Data-Mine Your Insecurities
tagline: Tired of your therapist only judging you for one hour a week? The Halo band offers *constant* feedback. Perfect for aspiring reality TV villains who need real-time analysis of their passive-aggressive sighs. Finally, an excuse to quantify your crippling self-doubt. It's progress, I guess.

title: Coloring Books for Cynics
tagline: For when adulting feels like a never-ending performance review. Unleash your inner rage (artistically!) instead of passive-aggressively 'cc'ing' your boss on that overdue report. Finally, a use for those dusty colored pencils besides pretending to homeschool. Because sometimes, pretty mandalas just don't cut it.

title: Document Your Next Squirrel Encounter
tagline: Planning to attach a camera to your cat for a low-budget remake of *Cujo*? Need irrefutable evidence that Brenda from accounting is, in fact, stealing your yogurt? This GoPro Hero 9's image stabilization will probably deliver...assuming your cat doesn't immediately hide under the porch. At least the footage of Brenda will be crisp.

title: Oy Vey, Shots!
tagline: Because sometimes dreidels just aren't chaotic enough. Elevate your Chanukah gatherings beyond polite latke consumption. Perfect for when you need to explain the Maccabean Revolt for the *seventh* time, and everyone conveniently 'forgets' how to spell 'menorah'. May your gelt overflow, and your liver forgive you.

title: No Sleep 'Til...Bath Time?
tagline: Need background noise for meticulously organizing your vintage toy collection by release date? This music exists. This deep dive into surfing history might be the only way to get him near the waves without risking a dramatic Coast Guard rescue. At least he'll have something to read *while* he's being rescued.

title: Gonzo Wisdom: Cheap Edition
tagline: So, you're housesitting for a professor who exclusively collects vintage typewriters and taxidermied squirrels. You've accidentally agreed to host his extremely judgmental book club. This biography of Hunter S. Thompson is probably the only thing preventing you from serving boxed wine and faking a sudden illness. At least it's cheaper than therapy.

title: Brain Teasers for Tiny Tyrants
tagline: Need to subtly assert intellectual dominance over your precocious niece at Thanksgiving? These riddles are perfect. Watch her little face contort with frustration as she tries to solve what a chimney sweep wears. Bonus points if you already know the answers.

title: Boozy Wisdom For Hermits
tagline: So, your Zoom happy hours are a *disaster*. You're mixing Manhattans with, uh, orange juice? This tome won't fix your personality, but it will prevent further cocktail atrocities. Ideal for the aspiring mixologist whose social life involves more cats than humans. Maybe *then* people will visit.

title: Gobble This, Good Boy!
tagline: So, your dog's got a refined palate, huh? Tired of the same old pressed kibble? Let him gnaw on a tendon. Imagine the look on Brenda's face at the dog park when Fido whips out a gourmet turkey snack instead of a drool-soaked tennis ball. Finally, a way to assert dominance in the canine culinary world.

title: Tiny Tyrant's Culinary Codex
tagline: So, your darling offspring has decided that *Chef* is their new career aspiration? Avoid years of therapy bills and preemptively arm them with this. Maybe, just maybe, they'll move beyond mac and cheese and onto… slightly more sophisticated mac and cheese. Consider it an investment in future dinner parties. Or at least preventing a cereal-only diet.

title: Dysfunctional Family Therapy, Boxed
tagline: Because sometimes you need a card game to remind you that your relatives aren't *that* insane. Perfect for awkward holiday gatherings where everyone's already three sheets to the wind and arguing about politics. At least this way, the insanity is structured and (hopefully) less scarring.

title: Esports Envy: Cardboard Chic
tagline: So, your parents *still* haven't upgraded you from the folding table? This "gaming desk" (and I use the term loosely) is the perfect temporary solution. Or, perhaps you're staging a minimalist art installation about the disposability of digital culture. Either way, it holds a monitor... mostly.
